sample_unit: LLM-generated exercise prescriptions (20 per scenario, 6 scenarios)

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM exercise prescriptions across repeated identical generations (semantic, structural, safety consistency)
links.effect: Mean cosine similarity 0.879-0.939; frequency consistent, but intensity varied, with 10-25% of resistance training intensity expressions unclassifiable; safety sentence counts varied significantly across scenarios (H=86.18, p<0.001).
links.quote: LLM-generated exercise prescriptions demonstrated high semantic consistency but showed variability in key quantitative components.

unlisted_practices: Use additional structural prompt constraints to improve consistency of LLM-generated exercise prescriptions
Expert validation of LLM-generated exercise prescriptions before clinical deployment

screen.reason: Evaluates the consistency, safety expressions, and variability of exercise prescriptions generated by an LLM across repeated simulations of clinical scenarios.
